values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

note: Rustic Michigan DNR state forest campground on a forested bluff overlooking Sunrise Lake, 6 miles east of LeRoy via Sunrise Lake Road and 15 Mile Road, Osceola County. Boat launch across the road from the campground, carry-in access by the parking area; bass, bluegill, perch, pike and trout. The Evart Cycle Loop (motorbikes only) is within half a mile. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: closure banner still up (lack of potable water, repairs underway, no reopening date) -> status confirmed (derived -> manual). $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump well, first-come only, 17 sites 'for tents and small trailers' (standard wording, silent on length), open all year (all confirmed); max stay 15 days written (was inherited). Type 'rustic', not equestrian; the page lists 'ORV trails or routes' (the Evart Cycle Loop, motorbikes only, half a mile away) and the table allows ORV operation between campground and trails, but it is not described as an ORV trail camp. Directions carry no road warning. Note trimmed of the closure text (status holds it) and field restatements.
